verdict_text: NO. The merge arithmetic is wrong: the second task vector is taken against `tmp` (the base already modified by the first merge) instead of the unmodified base, computing `tmp + λ(ft2 - tmp)` rather than `base + λ(ft1 - base) + λ(ft2 - base)`. This violates Required result step 2 and is exactly the ordering hazard the Objective warns about. The resulting values differ from the reference by more than the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance whenever ft1 differs from base.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
